assumptions: mmpdb's fragmentation, up to the size given.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which pairs of these molecules differ by one small change?

description: Matched molecular pairs (Hussain & Rea 2010) in a list of small molecules, as mmpdb finds them: pairs that differ by one change no larger than a heavy-atom limit, grouped by the change as a reaction SMIRKS, most pairs first. Indices are 0-based.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

max_size.description: largest changed part, in heavy atoms.

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

name: matched_molecular_pairs

summary.description: the pairs in words, generated from this run

transformations.description: each change as SMIRKS with its pairs (left, right, shared context)
